audience: food producers with a monthly ReciPal subscription

useCases.title: Review recipe nutrition and allergens
useCases.text: Read a recipe and its ingredient lines to review nutrition, allergens and quantities. Review label accuracy before using it on products.

useCases.title: Check raw-material stock
useCases.text: Review inventory and identify ingredients at risk of running out. These tools require a ReciPal inventory plan.

useCases.title: Copy a recipe for a larger batch
useCases.text: Create a scaled copy of a selected recipe, leaving the original unchanged. The new record counts against your vendor recipe allowance.

useCases.title: Record an ingredient price change
useCases.text: Add or update an ingredient cost. The change affects costs of recipes that use that ingredient.

useCases.title: Render a nutrition label
useCases.text: Start a PDF or PNG render, then check its status for a temporary download link. Rendering and status checks spend API quota.
